    13  In this file we define `Cardinal.toNat` to be the natural projection `Cardinal → ℕ`,

    29  /-- This function sends finite cardinals to the corresponding natural, and infinite cardinals
    30    to 0. -/
    31  noncomputable def toNat : Cardinal →*₀ ℕ :=
    32    ENat.toNatHom.comp (.ofClass toENat)
    33  
    34  @[simp] lemma toNat_toENat (a : Cardinal) : ENat.toNat (toENat a) = toNat a := rfl
    35

    37  theorem toNat_ofENat (n : ℕ∞) : toNat n = ENat.toNat n :=
